newsitem.title: USA: EQUITY INNS TO SELL 9 HOTELS FOR $47.25 MLN.
newsitem.headline: EQUITY INNS TO SELL 9 HOTELS FOR $47.25 MLN.

text.p: Equity Inns Inc, a real estate investment trust for U.S. hotel properties, said Wednesday it has agreed to sell nine Hampton Inn hotels to Hudson Hotels Corp for $47.25 million.
Equity Inns, which will post a gain from the sale, said the hotels did not meet its strategic acquisition profile.
The properties were part of a portfolio of 28 hotels acquired by Equity Inns from Growth Hotel Investors in June, Equity Inns said in a statement.
Closing is expected by the end of the third quarter, subject to customary documentation and conditions.

Separately, Equity Inns said that on July 31 it completed the purchase of the 28th property of the Growth Hotel portfolio. The property is a 131-room Hampton Inn located in Birmingham, Ala., the company said.
Equity Inns said it will not know the amount of the net gain until renovations are completed at the properties.
Hudson Hotels will pay $42.25 million in cash, and Equity Inns will assume a $5 million, two-year note at an interest rate of 10 percent, Equity Inns said.
The note is secured by two million shares of Hudson stock, Equity Inns said.
